description: Cheaper frozen block 1. Run only after the freeze-at-0.7 idea is read: apply this to its commit if it was kept (a 30% frozen window makes the saving gradable), else to E069. Make one change inside the existing block-1-frozen 32 px train graph: run block 1's BatchNorms in eval mode, using the running stats as of the freeze switch, with no further stat updates. The forward then skips the batch-stat reductions and running-stat writes. Use a Python flag fixed at trace time, with no data-dependent branch. Lookahead keeps blending block 1's buffers, now constant. Re-warm the frozen graph and its partial shapes in build() with channels_last tensors in the exact timed layout (E035). Run debug_nan.py and compare trial-0 with later-trial times.
